articles.title: Mystery solved? Why ‘sleeping’ ants suddenly explode with activity
articles.snippet: For decades, scientists have puzzled over what triggers some colonies of ants to burst from rest into community-wide action. Math may now explain this.
articles.summary: Scientists have finally used math to explain why resting ant colonies suddenly burst into activity. For decades, researchers were puzzled by what triggers these ants to wake up.

articles.title: Static electricity remains shockingly mysterious
articles.snippet: Despite studying static charge for centuries, scientists still aren’t clear on precisely how it works.
articles.summary: Even though scientists have studied static charge for hundreds of years, they still do not know exactly how it works. Researchers are still trying to figure out this shockingly mysterious process.
